exercise: Junior AI Engineer take-home, Alternative C - Questionnaire review
note: Records the AI configuration actually used for this exercise. No credentials are stored here. Categories that were not used are marked not-used rather than filled with invented components.

development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude used conversationally as the development assistant; the whole solution was generated with it, which the brief permits. No IDE plugin or agent framework was involved.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: No editor plugins or browser extensions affected this exercise.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: Anthropic Messages API. Model id, temperature (0), max_tokens (1024) and the live/replay/stub switch are all in app/config.py and overridable by environment variable.

skills.notes: The starter pack's generate-assignment-data skill was read but not installed or run; fixtures in data/additions.json were hand-written so each addition could be tied to a specific check. No custom skill was created: none was needed, and the brief states that a large collection of skills is not evidence of maturity.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: No CLAUDE.md, agent definition or subagent was used. Development was a single conversational session.

hooks_and_scripts.notes: No hooks were configured. A reviewer therefore has no hook command to read before running anything in this repository.

prompts_and_rules.notes: The application's system prompt and user-prompt builder live in app/drafting.py as module constants, in version control rather than in a separate prompt store. Instructions sit in the system prompt; document text is passed in the user message inside <passage> tags, so document content is data rather than instruction.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: No MCP servers or tool integrations. The application makes a single plain Messages API call per question and uses no tool calling.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: MODEL_API_KEY is the only secret. It is read from the environment, never written to disk, and never logged. .gitignore excludes .env and the SQLite database.
